column3: “Later” is supplied; “with them” replaces before the thousand.
“Near” replaces opposite; hand renders palm of the hand.
“Hips gave way” renders the loosening of the joints of his loins.
“Astrologers” renders Chaldeans; third-highest ruler specifies ruling third.
“Hearing the outcry” specifies the words as the reason for her coming.
People of every nation and language combines the three groups peoples, nations, and languages.
“Mind” renders heart; “an ox” renders plural oxen; the making of his heart is not explicit.
All your ways are brought into the phrase about God’s hand rather than separately belonging to Him.
Sending the palm and inscribing the writing become sending the hand that wrote.
